paragraph.content: How the theme reads card data from your products. Recommended: one product per card / pack item, with a variant option named "Purchase type" whose values are "card" and "pack".

purchase_option_name.label: Purchase option name
purchase_option_name.info: Variant option that holds the selling unit (card / pack). Shown as the unit next to prices.

rarity_tag_prefix.label: Rarity tag prefix
rarity_tag_prefix.info: e.g. tag rarity:secret-rare shows "Secret rare". The metafield custom.rarity takes priority.

unit_tag_prefix.label: Unit tag prefix
unit_tag_prefix.info: Fallback for products without the purchase option, e.g. tag unit:pack.

show_currency_code.label: Show currency code with prices (e.g. USD, EUR, SGD)

low_stock_threshold.label: Show "Only X left" at or below

paragraph.content: Leave a field empty to hide that channel in the footer.

whatsapp.info: Format: https://wa.me/ followed by the country code and number, digits only.
